title: Each new notes or debt line names its fix, and the report guard refuses a RECORDED gap with no started fix
why: Owner, 13:25 CST Nov 7: "I want the guard itself".
note:
Owner question item 355 (13:33 CST Nov 7): sort the 1,501 notes lines and 121 debts.
Coordinator pick, 13:30 CST Nov 7 (undoable): a new notes or debt line names its fix as `Fix: step:<slug>` only, or `Fix: none — <reason>` with a listed reason (owner decides, needs the Mac, rare and harmless, already fixed on main <sha>). A lane name does not count, because the PR ledger tracks steps.
Each new notes.md or debt line names its fix: a step, a lane, or a listed reason for none. The report guard refuses a RECORDED gap with no started fix. Done: red tests for a notes line with no fix and a RECORDED gap with no started fix, then green. Coordinator picks, 13:58 CST Nov 7 (undoable): a ratchet (open notes may not rise past main's count), and an `Until:` date on each `Fix: none` note. Both are added to this lane. The cap on that date is page item 360. Coordinator, 13:59 CST Nov 7: the Until check reads only added or edited lines. Expired lines show in the roadmap upkeep list. Owner, item 360, 14:41 CST: b, a `Fix: none` note is looked at again after 14 days (not the recommended 30). Lane notes-name-their-fix builds 360 b (coordinator 14:51 CST message). Old-notes scope answered from item 355 by triage, 09:18 CST Nov 8, no step notes-fix-lines and no page item: the owner's answer to item 355 (13:41 CST Nov 7) handled the backlog with a review, not a Fix line on each old note. The review ran (step notes-backlog-review: 1,629 items sorted into fix 184, delete 86, keep 1,359), its fixes run as the notes-fix, notes-delete and notes-keep steps, and item 358 a and b added sightings, expiry and one debt-fix lane per batch. So the Fix-line rule here, and fix-none-cite-check's cite rule, cover new lines only. #2002's count (1,456 of 1,507 bullets with no Fix line) likely holds the kept backlog plus lines added since the sort; the split is unmeasured. A sweep that rewrites old notes is not owed.
